verdict.rationale: While Together AI advertises OpenAI-compatible API access and 100+ hosted models (e.g., together-ai-docs-1, together-ai-docs-2, together-ai-docs-33), no evidence explicitly documents a GET /v1/models-style endpoint for programmatic catalog enumeration, and a probe for an OpenAPI spec that would confirm such an endpoint returned 404s across all candidate paths (together-ai-probe-3).
